newsitem.title: USA: Cambridge Soundworks sees lower Q2 profit.
newsitem.headline: Cambridge Soundworks sees lower Q2 profit.

text.p: Cambridge Soundworks Inc said it expects to report a lower profit for the second quarter ended December 29 compared with a year-ago because of lower wholesale sales to its largest customer and higher marketing costs.

The company did not give specific figures. It said its wholesale sales were down 26 percent from the year-ago quarter. The lower profit will come on revenues of about $18 million, a 20 percent increase, largely on higher sales at New England and San Francisco-area factory-direct stores, it added.
The company, which makes stereo, home theater and computer speakers, said it expects to report its second-quarter earnings on or about January 28.

A spokesman from the company said Cambridge Soundworks will earn at least $0.08 a share for the six months ended December 29 -- the same amount it earned for the six months of the same period last year.
He would not make a specific projection for the second quarter. The company earned $0.01 a share in its first quarter ended September 29.
